NO league+date+score fallback. Closing columns (B365C, PC, AvgC, MaxC) are read ONLY as the closing pair for CLV. The universe is built with `scripts/bars_opt.py universe --track standard --certified-fd` and stamped universe_standard_source.json; prepare and the study refuse any other.

holdout.unit: family = track x market-side; cells = league inside the family
holdout.fresh_run: maximal stretch of consecutive match dates of the family on which EVERY study-eligible row is fresh
holdout.choice: the MOST RECENT fresh run whose HOLDOUT PART (after the split) has at least one league with >= MIN_HOLDOUT_BETS (150) rows; a later run whose holdout part has no such league cannot host a 150-bet test and is skipped (counted). A run must still hold at least MIN_RUN_ROWS rows.
holdout.split: src.league_bars.in_period_split on the run's dates (owner 2026-11-08 rule: month boundary, CHECK part ~40% of match dates); HOLDOUT = run rows dated >= the split
holdout.selection: every study-eligible row of the family dated < the split; rows dated after the run's end are used by neither
holdout.no_fresh_run: the family gets NO historical PROVEN test (NO_FRESH_HOLDOUT); its cells stay PROMISING / UNPROVEN and wait for the live Clean Record from 2026-11-21; touched rows are never reused as a holdout

procedure.selection: src.bars_opt.study.select_core on the selection rows only (54 configurations, inner blocks, White reality check, per-league MODEL vs LEAGUE_WIDE, frozen per-league bars) - unchanged pre-registered protocol
procedure.frozen: the choices (configuration + per-league bars) are written with their sha256 BEFORE any holdout row is scored
procedure.test_once: each cell (family x league with frozen ON bars and >= 1 holdout row) is scored exactly once on its holdout rows with study.bet_with; the refit must equal the frozen choice; a second test into the same output is refused
procedure.no_peek: the monthly simulation (study.run_monthly) is NOT run in this protocol (it would read rows after the selection cut); every frame given to selection is asserted to hold no holdout row

proven_rule.ci: ROI 95% CI (block bootstrap by match date / max-of-three SE) lower bound above 0 AND Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.025
proven_rule.holm_family: every cell to be tested on the fresh holdout, counted after selection and BEFORE the test (a cell with no bet or no p-value still counts)
proven_rule.why_earlier_searches_do_not_enter: every earlier search (bars_opt SELECT / FINAL / monthly / serving, league_bars) chose among configurations using rows that are, by construction, NOT in this holdout: no holdout row's price existed for any of them. Selection here sees only pre-holdout rows. So the holdout is untouched data; the only multiplicity at the test is the number of cells tested on it.
proven_rule.p_resolution: a cell whose 2,000-draw bootstrap p sits at its floor is re-drawn (same block bootstrap by match date, vectorised) with ceil(P_RESOLUTION_HITS * holm_family / 0.025) draws

outputs: a verdicts-only proposal (TP-FH-<date>-<hash8>) under output/threshold_proposals/bars_oddsapi_hist/ with this file's sha256; no served bar changes. Live serving is unchanged: the monthly re-optimization on live data continues as before.
